mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and reduce mycophenolate metabolism, potentially increasing mycophenolate exposure and immunosuppressive effects; additionally, both agents have antiplatelet properties that may be additive.
action: Monitor for signs of mycophenolate toxicity (bone marrow suppression, GI effects); consider increased mycophenolate levels or bleeding risk; counsel patient on concurrent use and maintain consistent dosing.
